children: BGSF reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $25.13M, down 6.6% from the prior-year quarter, while net income was $344K compared with a net loss of $5.81M. Diluted EPS was $0.01 versus a loss per share of $0.28.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share - basic and diluted”.
Revenue declined 6.6% as billed hours fell 8.7%, reflecting cost pressures and increased competition; permanent-placement revenue partly offset the decline.
Gross margin increased to 36.1% from 35.9%, supported in part by higher permanent-placement revenue.
Administrative costs continued to decline following the sale of the Professional segment, including lower headcount, compensation and software costs.
After selling substantially all of its Professional segment in 2025, BGSF operates primarily in U.S. property management staffing.
Management expects liquidity to support normal working-capital needs and new-market openings over the next year; additional growth opportunities may require financing.
